description.value: You can cast force powers even mid-rage, so long as the power takes no more than 1 action to cast, doesn't demand concentration, and you aren't wearing heavy armor. While raging, any force power you cast that calls for a force attack roll or forces a saving throw deals extra damage equal to your rage damage — though if the power hits multiple targets, you only get to apply that bonus to one of them. Casting a power in this way counts as an attack for the purpose of keeping your rage going, and you may invoke Reckless Attack to gain advantage on a force power that requires an attack roll.
